'''Wacław Bolesław Marzantowicz'''<ref name=NPolska>{{cite web|title=prof. dr hab. Wacław Bolesław Marzantowicz|url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=34121&_k=dsch3g|website=Nowa Nauka Polska|publisher=National Information Processing Institute|access-date=19 July 2017|language=pl-PL}}</ref>  is a Polish mathematician known for his contributions in [[number theory]] and [[topology]]. He was President of the [[Polish Mathematical Society]] from 2014 to 2019.

== Biography ==
In 1967 he became the finalist of the 18th [[List of mathematics competitions|Mathematical Olympiad]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://om.edu.pl/stara_wersja/baza_uczestnikow/P-Uczen.php?numerucznia=1716|title=Database of Mathematical Olympiad in Poland finalists|date=March 2019|website=[[Polish Mathematical Society]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180513011332/https://om.edu.pl/stara_wersja/baza_uczestnikow/P-Uczen.php?numerucznia=1716|archive-date=May 13, 2018|url-status=dead|access-date=June 1, 2019}}</ref> In 1972, he graduated in mathematics at [[Adam Mickiewicz University]] in [[Poznań]]. He obtained his doctorate in Institute of Mathematics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]]{{r|KG_WMgene}} in 1977, based on the work ''Lefschetz Numbers of Maps Commuting with an Action of a Group'' written under the direction [[:pl:Kazimierz Gęba|Kazimierz Gęba]].<ref name=IMPASPhD>{{Cite web|url=http://www.impan.pl/Rada/Awanse/dr.html| title=PhDs at the MI PAS(since 1954)|url-status=|access-date=June 1, 2019| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402141214/http://www.impan.pl/Rada/Awanse/dr.html| archive-date=2015-04-02}}</ref><ref name=KG_WMgene>{{mathgenealogy|id=13914}}</ref> He got habilitation there in 1991, based on the work ''Invariant topology methods used in variational problems''.{{r|IMPANHab}}
[[File:MarzantowiczCOauthorsA.png|alt=Co-authors of Wacław Marzantowicz based on the number of publications indexed in MathSciNet (as of May 1, 2024).|left|thumb|330x330px|Co-authors of Wacław Marzantowicz based on the number of publications indexed in MathSciNet (as of May 1, 2024).]]
From 1993 to 1996, he was the director of the Institute of Mathematics [[University of Gdańsk]]. Since 1996, he has been working at Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science at the [[Adam Mickiewicz University]] in Poznań, where he heads the Department of Geometry and Topology. In 2002 he received the title of professor of mathematics. References to his papers can be found in mathematical databases.<ref name=MathSciNet>{{cite web | url =https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/author.html?mrauthid=120800 | title =List of publications in MathSciNet | author=Wacław Marzantowicz | year =1972 | publisher =American Mathematical Society | language =en | access-date = 2021-02-19}}</ref><ref name=StTrZBL>{{cite web | url =https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai%3Amarzantowicz.waclaw | title =List of publications in zbMATH | author=Wacław Marzantowicz | year =1972 |publisher =FIZ Karlsruhe GmbH | language =en  | access-date = 2021-02-19}}</ref>

From 1993 to 1996, he was the president of the Gdańsk Branch of the [[Polish Mathematical Society]] (PMS) and then its vice president (2011–2013).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ptm.org.pl/printpdf/21|title=Władze PTM w latach 1919-2013|date=March 2019|website=[[Polish Mathematical Society]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211027075118/https://www.ptm.org.pl/printpdf/21|archive-date=October 27, 2021|url-status=bot: unknown|access-date=June 1, 2019}}</ref> Since 2014, he has been the president of the Polish Mathematical Society.

== Honours and awards ==
Since 1995, he has been a member of the Scientific Council of the [[Juliusz Schauder|Juliusz Schauder Center for Nonlinear Studies]] at Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń, of which he was the Chairman from 2012 to 2018. He has served multiple terms on the Mathematics Committee of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (PAN), including the term 2024-2027. From 2016 to 2019, he was a representative of the Polish Mathematical Society (PTM) in the international mathematical cooperation program Silk-Road, conducted by the [[Chinese Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title = Silkroad Mathematics Center |date = 2016-12-10 |access-date = 2024-04-01 |agency = Chinese Mathematical Society |url=https://www.cms.org.cn/upload/editor/file/20200818/18162030016.pdf|lang = en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-05-11 |title=Silkroad Mathematics Center |url=https://www.cms.org.cn/en/Home/mathcenter/mathcenter_details/876.html |website=www.cms.org.cn}}<!-- auto-translated from Polish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> From 2010 to 2020, he represented PTM on the Council of the [[European Mathematical Society]] (EMS), and for the term 2021-2023, he was elected as a representative of individual members of EMS to this council.

He became the joint recipient of the [[Polish Mathematical Society#Stefan Banach Prize|Stefan Banach Prize]]<ref name=PMCBP>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/kategorie/konkursy/nagrody-glowne-ptm/nagroda-glowna-ptm-im-stefana-banacha|title=Laureates of Stefan Banach Prize|date=March 2019|website=[[Polish Mathematical Society]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190531061447/https://www.ptm.org.pl/kategorie/konkursy/nagrody-glowne-ptm/nagroda-glowna-ptm-im-stefana-banacha|archive-date=May 31, 2019|url-status=dead|access-date=June 1, 2019}}</ref> of the Polish Mathematical Society (alongside [[:pl:Jerzy Jezierski|Jerzy Jezierski]]).
